name: Flint
released_note: HF repo RecursiveSI/flint created 2026-10-21; Unsloth GGUFs and the Ollama tag the same week.

architecture.layer_mix: 2 dense + 47 MoE layers; 35 sliding-window (513 tokens) and 14 full-attention layers

summary: Recursive's coding-agent MoE: 39.8B total, about 2.5B active per token, 262K context, trained from scratch. Recursive reports 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified (its own evaluation). About 25 GB at 4-bit (Unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL), 23 GB as Ollama's default tag.

practical_baseline.reason: Released 2026-10-21; no reported or measured run recorded yet. The Ollama default tag is the simplest recorded path.
